text: This report presents for the information of the Board the Year End Report and the audit results for the year ended December 31, 2017. The auditor of record for the Board, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (PWC), audits these financial statements in accordance with Canadian public sector accounting standards and summarizes issues of audit significance and provides the communications required by their professional standards. The audit report is the section of the audit results where the auditors make their suggestions and recommendations, based on audit findings, to improve the accounting and internal control procedures. As noted in the full attached Audit Results, during the 2017 audit, the auditors are proposing to issue an unqualified report on the financial statements and have no significant internal control recommendations to report on. The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the Draft Audited Financial Statements attached as Appendix A within the 2017 Year-End Audit Report to the Board, pertaining to the operations of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place for the year ended December 31, 2017, attached as Appendix A to the report (May 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place. 2. Approved the transfer of the total 2017 operating surplus of $2,240,682 to the City of Toronto.
